create_post.title: Publish or schedule a post
create_post.description: Publish a post to one or more social networks, or schedule it with `schedule_date`. This is live the moment it succeeds. `platforms` names the networks; each network's own requirements go in its options object -- `youtube_options` needs a title, `pinterest_options` a board, `reddit_options` a subreddit. Use validate_post first if you are unsure.

post.description: The post text. Networks truncate differently -- check_post_length says how.

platforms.description: Networks to publish to, e.g. ["twitter", "linkedin", "instagram"]. Each must already be linked to the profile.

media_urls.description: Publicly reachable image or video urls to attach. Ayrshare fetches them, so signed or private urls fail.

is_video.description: Treat the attached media as video. Required for video on some networks.

schedule_date.description: ISO 8601 time to publish at, e.g. "2026-10-01T14:00:00Z". Omit to publish immediately.

validate_scheduled.description: Validate a scheduled post's network requirements now rather than at send time.

first_comment.description: A comment to post immediately after publishing, as {"comment": "...", "platforms": [...]} -- the usual place for links on Instagram.

disable_comments.description: Turn off comments on the published post, where the network allows it.

shorten_links.description: Rewrite links through Ayrshare's shortener so clicks are tracked.

auto_schedule.description: Use a saved posting schedule, e.g. {"schedule": true, "title": "default"}.

auto_repost.description: Repost automatically on a cadence, per Ayrshare's auto-repost options.

requires_approval.description: Hold the post for approval instead of publishing -- released with update_post.

idempotency_key.description: Your own key, so a retried call cannot double-post.

notes.description: Internal notes kept on the post, never published.

facebook_options.description: Facebook-specific options -- reels, stories, link preview and targeting.

google_business_options.description: Google Business Profile options -- call to action, offer, event.

instagram_options.description: Instagram options -- reels, stories, collaborators, location, thumbnail.

linkedin_options.description: LinkedIn options -- article link, visibility, targeting.

pinterest_options.description: Pinterest options -- `boardId` is required for a pin.

tiktok_options.description: TikTok options -- privacy level, duet/stitch/comment permissions.

twitter_options.description: X/Twitter options -- thread, reply settings, poll.

youtube_options.description: YouTube options -- `title` is required, plus visibility, playlist, thumbnail and category.

output.description: The result per network, each with its post id, live url and status -- one network can fail while others succeed, so check every entry.

id.description: Ayrshare's own id for the post.

create_bulk_posts.title: Publish many posts from a CSV
create_bulk_posts.description: Queue a batch of posts from a CSV of rows, each with its own text, networks and schedule date. Every row publishes on its own schedule, so an error in the file is an error in production.

posts.description: The posts to queue, each an object shaped like create_post's body -- `post`, `platforms`, optionally `scheduleDate` and per-network options.

output.description: The queued posts and any per-row errors.

get_post.title: Get a post
get_post.description: Read one post by its Ayrshare id -- its text, target networks, live urls and per-network status. The way to check whether a scheduled post actually went out.

post_id.description: Ayrshare's id for the post, from create_post or get_history.

output.description: The post and its per-network results.

update_post.title: Update or approve a post
update_post.description: Change a scheduled post's date or notes, or set `approved` to release a post that was held for approval. A post already published can only have its metadata changed, not its content.

approved.description: Approve a post that was created with `requires_approval` -- this publishes it.

schedule_date.description: New ISO 8601 publish time, for a post that has not gone out yet.

scheduled_pause.description: Pause a scheduled post without deleting it.

disable_comments.description: Turn comments on or off, where the network allows it.

youtube_options.description: Updated YouTube metadata -- title, description, visibility.

delete_post.title: Delete a post
delete_post.description: Delete a post from the networks that allow it, and from Ayrshare's history. Networks that do not support deletion keep the post -- use `mark_manual_deleted` to record that you removed it by hand. `delete_all_scheduled` clears the entire scheduled queue.

post_id.description: Ayrshare's id for the post to delete.

post_ids.description: Several post ids to delete at once.

delete_all_scheduled.description: Delete every scheduled post that has not gone out yet.

mark_manual_deleted.description: Record the post as deleted in history without calling the network.

retry_post.title: Retry a failed post
retry_post.description: Re-attempt a post that failed on one or more networks. Only the failed networks are retried, so a partially successful post does not double-post.

post_id.description: Ayrshare's id for the failed post.

copy_post.title: Copy a post to other networks
copy_post.description: Republish an existing post to additional networks, keeping its text and media. Publishes immediately unless a schedule date is given.

schedule_date.description: ISO 8601 time to publish the copies at.

get_history.title: Get post history
get_history.description: Read the profile's posting history, newest first -- what went out, when, to which networks and whether it succeeded. `status` of "error" is the quickest way to find what failed.

platforms.description: Only posts sent to these networks.

start_date.description: Only posts on or after this ISO 8601 date.

end_date.description: Only posts on or before this ISO 8601 date.

last_days.description: Only posts from the last N days.

status.description: Only posts in this state, e.g. "success", "error" or "pending".

type.description: Only posts of this kind, e.g. "scheduled".

get_history_by_platform.title: Get post history for one network
get_history_by_platform.description: Read the posts published to a single network, which is the per-network view get_history flattens.

last_days.description: Only posts from the last N days.

validate_post.title: Validate a post before publishing
validate_post.description: Check a post against each target network's rules -- text length, media type and size, required options -- without publishing anything. The rehearsal for create_post.

output.description: Per-network validation results and the problems found.

check_post_length.title: Check a post's length per network
check_post_length.description: Measure a post's text against each network's limit, counting the way that network counts -- links and emoji are not one character everywhere.

output.description: The measured length and limit per network.

moderate_post.title: Check a post for policy problems
moderate_post.description: Run text through Ayrshare's moderation check before publishing, which flags content likely to be rejected or to cause account problems.

output.description: The moderation verdict and the categories flagged.

check_subreddit.title: Check whether a subreddit exists
check_subreddit.description: Verify a subreddit before posting to it -- a Reddit post with a wrong or restricted subreddit fails at publish time, not at compose time.

subreddit.description: The subreddit name, without the "r/" prefix.

output.description: Whether the subreddit exists and accepts posts.

get_post_analytics.title: Get analytics for a post
get_post_analytics.description: Read one post's engagement per network -- impressions, likes, comments, shares, saves. Networks report on a delay and some metrics only appear after a threshold, so a fresh post can legitimately look empty.

get_social_analytics.title: Get account analytics
get_social_analytics.description: Read account-level analytics per network -- follower counts, profile views, reach. `daily` returns a day-by-day series rather than totals.

daily.description: Return a daily series instead of period totals.

quarters.description: How many quarters of history to include.

period_60_days.description: Use a 60-day window rather than the default period.

get_instagram_online_followers.title: Get when Instagram followers are online
get_instagram_online_followers.description: Read the hourly distribution of when an Instagram account's followers are active -- the input to choosing a posting time.

output.description: Follower activity by hour and weekday.

get_youtube_playlists.title: Get YouTube playlists
get_youtube_playlists.description: Read the linked YouTube channel's playlists with their ids, which a post's `youtube_options` can add a video to.

get_user.title: Get the profile and its linked accounts
get_user.description: Read the current profile -- which social networks are linked, their usernames and display names, and the plan's limits. The cheapest call that proves the API key works, and the way to learn which `platforms` values are valid.

output.description: The profile, its linked accounts and plan limits.

list_profiles.title: List user profiles
list_profiles.description: Read the user profiles under this account -- one per end customer on the Business plan -- with each profile's key and linked networks.

create_profile.title: Create a user profile
create_profile.description: Create a user profile for an end customer. The response carries the `profileKey` that scopes later calls to that customer -- keep it, it is how their posts and analytics are addressed.

title.description: A name for the profile, usually the customer's name.

messaging_active.description: Enable the messaging API for this profile.

disable_social.description: Networks this profile may not link, e.g. ["tiktok"].

hide_top_header.description: Hide the header in the profile's linking page.

hide_logo.description: Hide the Ayrshare logo in the linking page.

top_header.description: Header text for the linking page.

sub_header.description: Sub-header text for the linking page.

team.description: Create the profile as a team profile.

tags.description: Your own tags for grouping profiles.

output.description: The created profile, including its profileKey and refId.

update_profile.title: Update a user profile
update_profile.description: Change a user profile's title, branding or messaging settings.

profile_key.description: The profile key of the profile to change.

messaging_active.description: Enable or disable messaging for the profile.

delete_profile.title: Delete a user profile
delete_profile.description: Delete a user profile, unlinking its social accounts and losing its history. Irreversible, and the customer's scheduled posts go with it.

profile_key.description: The profile key of the profile to delete.

output.description: Confirmation that the profile was deleted.

unlink_social_network.title: Unlink a social network from a profile
unlink_social_network.description: Disconnect one network from the profile. Scheduled posts targeting it start failing, so clear the queue first.

output.description: Confirmation that the network was unlinked.

create_link_session.title: Create a social linking session
create_link_session.description: Create a hosted session url a customer can open to connect their own social accounts. The modern alternative to generating a JWT yourself.

profile_key.description: The profile the customer should link accounts to.

redirect.description: Where to send the customer after linking.

allowed_social.description: Networks the customer may link, e.g. ["instagram", "facebook"].

expires_in.description: How long the session link stays valid, in seconds.

output.description: The session, including the url to send the customer to.

get_link_session.title: Get a linking session
get_link_session.description: Read a linking session's state -- whether the customer completed it, and what they linked.

revoke_link_session.title: Revoke a linking session
revoke_link_session.description: Invalidate a linking session url so it can no longer be used.

output.description: Confirmation that the session was revoked.

generate_jwt.title: Generate a linking JWT
generate_jwt.description: Mint a signed url that lets one customer link their social accounts. Needs the account's private key and the customer's `profile_key`; the older alternative to create_link_session.

domain.description: Your Ayrshare domain, from the dashboard.

private_key.description: The account's private key, from the dashboard.

profile_key.description: The profile the customer will link accounts to.

logout.description: Log the customer out of any existing session first.

redirect.description: Where to send them after linking.

expires_in.description: How long the url stays valid, in seconds.

verify.description: Verify the key pair without issuing a url.

output.description: The signed linking url and its expiry.

get_user_lookups.title: Look up connected account details
get_user_lookups.description: Read the identifiers of the profile's connected accounts -- page ids, channel ids, usernames -- which per-network options often need.

get_pinterest_boards.title: Get Pinterest boards
get_pinterest_boards.description: Read the linked Pinterest account's boards with their ids. A pin needs `boardId` in `pinterest_options`, and this is where it comes from.

get_whatsapp_profile.title: Get the WhatsApp business profile
get_whatsapp_profile.description: Read the linked WhatsApp business profile's details and phone numbers.

upload_media.title: Upload media to the gallery
upload_media.description: Upload an image or video to Ayrshare's gallery and get back a url a post can use. The fix for media that lives somewhere Ayrshare cannot fetch. `file` is a base64 data string or a public url.

file.description: The media, as a base64 data string ("data:image/png;base64,...") or a publicly reachable url for Ayrshare to fetch.

output.description: The uploaded media, including the url to use in a post.

get_upload_url.title: Get a direct upload URL
get_upload_url.description: Request a signed url for uploading a large video straight to storage, bypassing the size limit on upload_media. You then PUT the bytes to that url yourself.

file_name.description: Name of the file you are about to upload.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. "video/mp4".

output.description: The signed upload url and the media url to use afterwards.

list_media.title: List media in the gallery
list_media.description: Read the media already uploaded to the profile's gallery, with their urls.

get_media_metadata.title: Get media metadata
get_media_metadata.description: Read a media file's dimensions, duration, codec and size -- what you need to know whether a network will accept it.

verify_media_url.title: Check that a media URL is reachable
verify_media_url.description: Confirm Ayrshare can actually fetch a media url before a post depends on it -- the usual cause of a post failing on one network only.

output.description: Whether the url is reachable and what it returned.

resize_media.title: Resize an image
resize_media.description: Resize or crop an image to a network's required aspect ratio, returning a new url -- rather than having the post rejected for its dimensions.

platform.description: The network whose dimensions to fit, e.g. "instagram".

stretch.description: Stretch to fill rather than padding.

background_color.description: Padding colour when not stretching, as a hex value.

get_comments.title: Get a post's comments
get_comments.description: Read the comments on a published post across the networks that expose them, with each commenter and comment id.

post_id.description: Ayrshare's post id, or a network post id with `search_platform_id` set.

search_platform_id.description: Treat `post_id` as the network's own post id rather than Ayrshare's.

post_comment.title: Comment on a post
post_comment.description: Add a comment to a published post as the connected account. This is public the moment it succeeds.

post_id.description: Ayrshare's post id to comment on.

media_urls.description: Media to attach, where the network allows it.

search_platform_id.description: Treat `post_id` as the network's own post id.

reply_to_comment.title: Reply to a comment
reply_to_comment.description: Reply to a specific comment as the connected account -- publicly visible immediately.

comment_id.description: The comment to reply to, from get_comments.

delete_comments.title: Delete comments
delete_comments.description: Delete a comment, or all Ayrshare-created comments on a post. Only comments the connected account owns can go.

comment_id.description: The comment id, or the post id to clear comments from.

get_messages.title: Get direct messages
get_messages.description: Read direct messages and conversations for one network. Requires messaging to be enabled on the profile and the network to support it.

send_message.title: Send a direct message
send_message.description: Send a DM as the connected account. It reaches a real person at once, and networks enforce their own messaging windows -- a reply outside the window is rejected.

platform.description: The network to send on, e.g. "instagram".

recipient_id.description: The recipient's id on that network, from get_messages.

get_auto_response.title: Get the messaging auto-response
get_auto_response.description: Read the configured automatic reply for incoming direct messages.

set_auto_response.title: Set the messaging auto-response
set_auto_response.description: Configure an automatic reply to incoming DMs. Every matching message gets it, so word it as something a customer should actually receive.

platform.description: The network the auto-response applies to.

get_reviews.title: Get reviews
get_reviews.description: Read the reviews on a linked account -- Google Business Profile, Facebook -- with their ratings and text.

platform.description: The network to read reviews from, e.g. "gmb".

get_review.title: Get one review
get_review.description: Read a single review by id, with its rating, text and any existing reply.

platform.description: The network the review is on.

reply_to_review.title: Reply to a review
reply_to_review.description: Post a public reply to a review as the business. Visible to everyone who reads the review, and networks allow only one reply per review -- posting again replaces it.

platform.description: The network the review is on, e.g. "gmb".

delete_review_reply.title: Delete a review reply
delete_review_reply.description: Remove the business's reply from a review. The review itself stays.

platform.description: The network the review is on.

review_id.description: The review whose reply should go.

output.description: Confirmation that the reply was deleted.

set_auto_schedule.title: Set an auto-schedule
set_auto_schedule.description: Define posting times a post can be dropped into with `auto_schedule`, so content lands at chosen hours rather than whenever it was created.

schedule.description: Times of day to publish at, as "HH:MM" strings in UTC.

title.description: Name for this schedule. Omit to set the default one.

start_date.description: Date the schedule starts applying, ISO 8601.

days_of_week.description: Days the schedule applies to, as numbers with 1 for Monday.

list_auto_schedules.title: List auto-schedules
list_auto_schedules.description: Read the saved posting schedules on the profile, with their times and titles.

get_pending_auto_schedule.title: List posts waiting on an auto-schedule
get_pending_auto_schedule.description: Read the posts queued into an auto-schedule but not yet published -- the pipeline of what is about to go out.

delete_auto_schedule.title: Delete an auto-schedule
delete_auto_schedule.description: Delete a saved schedule. Posts already queued into it keep their times; new posts can no longer reference it.

title.description: The schedule's title. Omit to delete the default schedule.

output.description: Confirmation that the schedule was deleted.

list_automations.title: List automations
list_automations.description: Read the profile's automations -- rules that act on triggers such as a new comment or mention, without a human in the loop.

get_automation.title: Get an automation
get_automation.description: Read one automation's triggers, actions and current state.

create_automation.title: Create an automation
create_automation.description: Create an automation that reacts to activity on a network -- reply to comments, DM new followers. Once created it acts on real accounts without further review, so keep the triggers narrow.

platform.description: The network the automation runs on.

triggers.description: What starts it, in Ayrshare's trigger shape.

actions.description: What it does when triggered, in Ayrshare's action shape.

update_automation.title: Update an automation
update_automation.description: Change an automation's triggers or actions. It keeps running against the new definition immediately.

triggers.description: The complete trigger list after the update.

actions.description: The complete action list after the update.

active.description: Turn the automation on or off.

get_automation_activity.title: Get an automation's activity
get_automation_activity.description: Read what an automation has actually done -- every trigger it fired on and action it took. The first place to look when an automation misbehaves.

delete_automation.title: Delete an automation
delete_automation.description: Delete an automation. It stops acting immediately; its activity log goes too.

output.description: Confirmation that the automation was deleted.

list_feeds.title: List RSS feeds
list_feeds.description: Read the RSS feeds wired to the profile, which auto-post new items to the chosen networks.

add_feed.title: Add an RSS feed
add_feed.description: Wire an RSS feed to the profile so new items publish automatically. Every new item becomes a live post, so point it at a feed you control.

platforms.description: Networks new items should publish to.

use_first_image.description: Attach the item's first image to the post.

auto_hashtag.description: Have Ayrshare add hashtags to each item.

update_feed.title: Update an RSS feed
update_feed.description: Change a feed's url, target networks or posting options.

platforms.description: The complete network list after the update.

delete_feed.title: Delete an RSS feed
delete_feed.description: Stop auto-posting from a feed. Items already published stay where they are.

output.description: Confirmation that the feed was removed.

recommend_hashtags.title: Recommend hashtags for a keyword
recommend_hashtags.description: Get hashtag suggestions for a keyword, with popularity data -- the input to a post's tags rather than guessing.

keyword.description: The keyword to get hashtags for.

search_hashtags.title: Search hashtags
search_hashtags.description: Search for hashtags matching a term, with usage counts.

check_banned_hashtags.title: Check for banned hashtags
check_banned_hashtags.description: Check hashtags against the networks' banned lists. A banned tag can suppress a whole post's reach, which is why this exists.

hashtags.description: Comma-separated hashtags to check, without the "#".

output.description: Which of the hashtags are banned or restricted.

auto_hashtags.title: Add hashtags to a post automatically
auto_hashtags.description: Have Ayrshare pick and append hashtags to a piece of text, returning the rewritten post rather than publishing it.

post.description: The post text to add hashtags to.

position.description: Where to place them, e.g. "auto" or "end".

output.description: The post text with hashtags added.

generate_post_text.title: Generate post text
generate_post_text.description: Have Ayrshare write post copy from a prompt or description, optionally with hashtags and emoji. Returns text -- publishing it is a separate call.

text.description: What the post should be about.

media_urls.description: Media to take into account when writing.

hashtags.description: Include hashtags in the generated text.

twitter.description: Keep the text within X/Twitter's limit.

rewrite_post.title: Rewrite post text
rewrite_post.description: Rewrite existing copy -- shorter, different tone, another network's conventions -- without publishing it.

instruction.description: How to rewrite it, e.g. "shorter and more formal".

translate_post.title: Translate post text
translate_post.description: Translate post copy into another language, returning the translation.

language.description: Target language as an ISO code, e.g. "es" or "fr".

generate_alt_text.title: Generate image alt text
generate_alt_text.description: Produce accessible alt text for an image, which several networks accept on a post's media.

analyse_sentiment.title: Analyse sentiment
analyse_sentiment.description: Score text for sentiment -- useful on incoming comments and reviews before deciding how to reply.

transcribe_video.title: Transcribe a video
transcribe_video.description: Transcribe a video's audio to text, which is where captions and subtitles for a social video come from.

create_short_link.title: Create a short link
create_short_link.description: Shorten a url through Ayrshare so its clicks are tracked, with optional UTM parameters attached.

get_link_analytics.title: Get short link analytics
get_link_analytics.description: Read click counts and referrers for the profile's short links.

start_date.description: Only clicks on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only clicks on or before this date.

output.description: Click analytics for the short links.

update_short_link.title: Update a short link
update_short_link.description: Point an existing short link at a different destination -- the link itself keeps working, so anything already published still resolves.

search_tweets.title: Search X/Twitter for a keyword
search_tweets.description: Search recent X/Twitter posts for a keyword -- social listening rather than posting. Subject to X's own rate limits.

search_facebook_pages.title: Search Facebook pages
search_facebook_pages.description: Find Facebook pages by name -- the lookup before monitoring a competitor's page.

search.description: The page name to search for.

search_linkedin.title: Search LinkedIn organisations
search_linkedin.description: Find LinkedIn organisations by name, with their ids.

search.description: The organisation name to search for.

get_brand_by_user.title: Get public brand data for a user
get_brand_by_user.description: Read public profile and engagement data for a named social account -- competitive benchmarking rather than your own analytics.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Read the registered webhooks and the actions each listens for. Set `all_webhooks` to include every user profile's, not just this one's.

all_webhooks.description: Include webhooks registered on every user profile of the account.

register_webhook.title: Register a webhook
register_webhook.description: Subscribe an HTTPS endpoint to an Ayrshare action -- "scheduled" for scheduled-post results, "social" for account changes, plus feed, batch, messages, mentions, comments, automations and suspended. `secret` enables HMAC signing, which you should verify on receipt.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint Ayrshare should POST to.

secret.description: Shared secret used to HMAC-sign each delivery.

unregister_webhook.title: Unregister a webhook
unregister_webhook.description: Remove a webhook subscription. Deliveries stop at once and missed events are not replayed.

action.description: The action whose webhook should be removed.

output.description: Confirmation that the webhook was removed.

get_webhook_history.title: Get webhook delivery history
get_webhook_history.description: Read recent webhook deliveries and their responses -- the place to look when your endpoint says it never received an event.

rotate_webhook_secret.title: Rotate the webhook signing secret
rotate_webhook_secret.description: Issue a new HMAC signing secret for webhooks. Deliveries are signed with the new secret immediately, so update your verifier at the same time.

get_youtube_categories.title: Get YouTube categories
get_youtube_categories.description: Read YouTube's video categories for a country, whose ids a post's `youtube_options` can set.

get_reddit_flair.title: Get a subreddit's flairs
get_reddit_flair.description: Read the flairs a subreddit offers. Many subreddits reject posts without one, so this is a prerequisite for Reddit posting.

get_instagram_collaborators.title: Check Instagram collaborator eligibility
get_instagram_collaborators.description: Check whether accounts can be tagged as collaborators on an Instagram post -- an invitation that fails silently if the account does not allow it.

output.description: Whether that account can be added as a collaborator.

set_youtube_watermark.title: Set a YouTube channel watermark
set_youtube_watermark.description: Apply a branding watermark image to the linked YouTube channel's videos.

watermark_url.description: Publicly reachable image url for the watermark.

output.description: Confirmation that the watermark was set.

get_ad_accounts.title: List Facebook ad accounts
get_ad_accounts.description: Read the Facebook ad accounts available to the linked page, whose ids boost_post needs.

boost_post.title: Boost a Facebook post
boost_post.description: Turn a published Facebook post into a paid ad. **This spends money** -- the budget and schedule you pass are charged to the ad account -- and it cannot be undone, only paused with update_boosted_ad.

ad_account_id.description: The ad account that pays, from get_ad_accounts.

budget.description: Total budget in the ad account's currency.

duration_days.description: How many days to run the boost for.

targeting.description: Audience targeting -- geography, interests, age -- in Facebook's shape.

output.description: The created ad, with its id and status.

list_boosted_ads.title: List boosted ads
list_boosted_ads.description: Read the boosts created through Ayrshare, with their status and spend.

update_boosted_ad.title: Update or pause a boosted ad
update_boosted_ad.description: Change a boost's status or budget -- setting the status to paused is how you stop spend on a live ad.

get_ad_spend.title: Get ad spend history
get_ad_spend.description: Read what boosts have cost -- spend and results per ad over time.

ad_account_id.description: The ad account to report on.

start_date.description: Only spend on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only spend on or before this date.

search_ad_interests.title: Search Facebook ad interests
search_ad_interests.description: Find interest targeting options by name, with the ids a boost's `targeting` object takes.

search_ad_cities.title: Search Facebook ad cities
search_ad_cities.description: Find city targeting keys by name, for a boost's geographic targeting.

output.description: Matching cities and their targeting keys.

search_ad_regions.title: Search Facebook ad regions
search_ad_regions.description: Find region targeting keys by name, for a boost's geographic targeting.

output.description: Matching regions and their targeting keys.
